The included exact verifier independently enumerates all 64 maximum cocliques, all 240 maximum cliques/partitions, and every local distance profile and returns VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: The base code is important in the source precisely because it violates a maximality claim by admitting a nonadditive one-coordinate extension. Classifying every such extension, proving uniqueness up to the source equivalence, and giving their common distance profile answers the natural structural question created by that counterexample. This is a complete classification of a motivated finite extension problem, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
